slides.texte_overlay:
How to instantly become
more noticeable to girls
(the right way)
Be good with people she cares about. Her friends, the waiter, the shy guy at the edge of the group. Girls notice how you treat everyone around you, way more than how you treat them.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Watch how much easier conversations get when you actually have something interesting to bring.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Watch how much easier conversations get when you have something to bring.

slides.texte_overlay: Be into something. A sport, cooking, old films, building things. Talk about it with real energy. Real passion is attractive, and it gives her a good reason to ask you questions instead of the other way around.
Take care of the basics. Clean nails, fresh breath, a shirt that fits, a haircut that's not three months overdue. None of it is expensive. All of it gets noticed before you even say hello.
Laugh easily. At her jokes, at the situation, at yourself. A guy who's relaxed enough to laugh is fun to be around. A guy who's trying to look cool all night is exhausting to talk to.
Respect her time and her answer. If she's busy, she's busy. If she says no, smile and say "No worries, have a good night." How you handle a no says more about you than any line ever could.

Look like you're enjoying your own night. Good friends, good music, no checking the room every minute. The guy having a great time on his own is always more noticeable than the one waiting to be noticed.
